dish_classes: makki di roti sarso ka saag

data.split_policy: Keep provided raw train as train; exact-content groups from provided validation are deterministically divided per class into valid/test. Drop exact label conflicts and cross-split same-label pHash distance <=4. Test takes precedence.
data.limitations: Perceptual hashing is a heuristic. It may exclude similar distinct photos and miss near duplicates. Raw test is carved from source validation, not an independent external benchmark.

rejection.policy: Validation-only shared threshold (minimum 50% estimate, >=15 accepted examples and >=70% accepted accuracy in each domain); require center stability and training novelty distance.

selection: Mean of raw-food and dish macro class validation accuracy; training-only 3-fold correctness calibration. Test not used for fitting, model selection or threshold selection in this run.
limitations: Single dominant-item classification; no ingredient segmentation. Both raw and dish test splits have been inspected across development rounds and are not fresh external blind benchmarks. Source annotations are classification labels, not boxes or masks. Dataset does not provide ingredient nutrition.

verification.synthetic_white_liquid_pan: uncertain; no automatic dish or ingredient profile
